title: American Consulate General - Enquiry Re Hildegard Mins Et Al

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY 900/20）

S...ls Special Branch Addn. File No.................... Date November 5, 1941.

SUBJECT: American Consulate General's Enquiry re
Hildegard Minz et al.

In reply to an enquiry dated November 4th, 1941
from the American Consulate General re Hildegard Minz
et al, I have to report as follows:-

MINZ, Hildegard,                                No record
Age 33, German,
670 Yangtsepoo Road.

DIEABOURG, Efreim,                              No record
Age 31, without nationality,
1167 Bubbling Well Road,
Apt. 11.

CHERENSON, Israel,                              No record
Age 32, without nationality,
1167 Bubbling Well Road,
Apt. 11.

KOMOR, Lenard E.,                               No record
Age 27, Hungarian,
92 Amherst Avenue.

GRABSCHEID, Michael,                            No record
Age 41, Polish,
25 Quinsan Gardens.

LANDSMAN, Mojsesz,                              No record
Age 46, Polish,
HICKM, P.O. Box 1485.

LOWENTHAL, Ella,                                No record
Age 56, German,
30 Rue du Boisson.

MODELI, Josef and Rischel,                      No record
Age and nationality unknown,
c/o Rabbi Ashkenazi, 308
Cardinal Mercier.

SZAPIRO, Solomon, & wife,                       No record
age and nationality unknown,
c/o Rabbi Ashkenazi,
308 Cardinal Mercier.

（批：American Consulate General. 5.11.41 Sl）
（批：Sent today）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 5 NOV 1941）
（印：FILE 5.11.41.）

42.511

J.E. Cromwell
R. S. I.

A. C. (Special Branch).

XED BY
REGISTRY
DATE 6/11/41
